coverage: Measured angular sector only; no extrapolation or full-sphere reconstruction
levelBasis: Compensated comparison-method gain copied from supplied workbooks; exported polarization basis retained

validation.phaseData: Copied unchanged from supplied compensated workbooks

sllDefinition.reference: Maximum co-pol gain on this same El=0 Az cut
sllDefinition.mainLobe: First local minimum on each side outside the connected -3 dB region, with valley prominence >=1 dB
sllDefinition.sidelobe: Highest interior sampled local maximum beyond those minima
sllDefinition.smoothing: None; raw gain samples are retained
sllDefinition.missingBoundary: No SLL assigned to that side; coverage marked incomplete
sllDefinition.review: Weak-valley flag below 3 dB or incomplete coverage; inspect annotated cut
sllDefinition.sensitivity: 0, 0.5, 1, 2, and 3 dB valley-prominence results retained per state
